run_convert_idefics3_weights_cli: run the convert_idefics3_weights_to_hf script with --original_model_id, --output_hub_path, and --push_to_hub arguments
convert_idefics3_hub_to_hf: convert Idefics3 model weights from original format to HuggingFace format and save locally or push to hub
convert_state_dict_to_hf: convert state dict keys from original Idefics3 naming to HuggingFace naming convention
merge_weights: merge embedding and fully-connected weights according to WEIGHTS_TO_MERGE_MAPPING and return combined state dict
get_config: load and reconstruct Idefics3Config from original model's config.json on the hub
